defaults.fixtureNote: Every fixture pins the component to the 282px the Figma set draws at (3318:18167) and passes the English placeholder the frames show. The set's country is Moldova, which is also the component's default.
defaults.maskNote: Figma draws the flag as the 🇲🇩 emoji (3318:18569); the component ships an SVG glyph set, because a regional-indicator pair has no glyph on Windows at all. The two will never match pixel for pixel, so the flag is masked and its box is pinned by style parity instead.

states.name: default-large-local

expect.note: Figma 3318:18171 pads 0 16px 0 6px — the leading edge is tight because the country chip sits in it — and gaps 12px between the chip and the number.

Figma 3318:18567 is a fixed 36px chip, #F5F5F5 at radius 4px, padded 0 12px 0 8px, with its contents 4px apart (3318:18568). The 12px trailing padding is what the Local variant puts where International has its chevron.
Figma 3318:18570 sets the dial code in Desktop/Body/Default #121212.
Figma 3318:18169 is Desktop/Body/Small — regular, not medium — in #383838; 3318:18168 gaps the label and its asterisk by 4px.
Figma 3318:18175 is Desktop/Body/Default. Its #757575 is the placeholder colour, which lives on ::placeholder and no computed style can reach.
The Local chip has no chevron — the country is fixed, so there is nothing to open. 7854:7374 adds one only in the International variant.

Figma 7854:6661 keeps the Local frame's padding and gap; only the chip differs between the two types.
